# netbox_vpn_tunnel_termination (Data Source)

Retrieves a single vpn tunnel termination from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_vpn_tunnel_termination" "example" {
  id = 1
}

output "vpn_tunnel_termination_id" {
  value = data.netbox_vpn_tunnel_termination.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the vpn tunnel termination.
- `outside_ip_id` (Number) The ID of the outside ip associated with the vpn tunnel termination.
- `role` (String) The role of the vpn tunnel termination.
- `termination_type` (String) The termination type of the vpn tunnel termination.
- `tunnel_id` (Number) The ID of the tunnel associated with the vpn tunnel termination.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) When the vpn tunnel termination was created.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the vpn tunnel termination, as a map of field name to value.
- `last_updated` (String) When the vpn tunnel termination was last changed.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
- `termination` (String) The termination of the vpn tunnel termination.
- `termination_id` (Number) The termination id of the vpn tunnel termination.
